report_metadata.title: AI Training / Micro-Work Platforms Research for OWNEX Integration
report_metadata.research_source: aggregated web research (reviews, official sites, community reports)
report_metadata.methodology: Each platform evaluated across 5 dimensions (Activity, Payments, Ease of Access, Volume, Quality) scored 1-10. Quality prioritizes coding/reasoning tasks over labeling.

platforms.name: DataAnnotation.tech
platforms.signup_status: Open for US, UK, Canada, Ireland, Australia, New Zealand. Others see waitlist.

countries.notes: Extremely limited — 6 countries only. No LATAM. Virtual waitlist for all others.

payments.speed: Weekly, typically 1-3 days after period close
payments.notes: Highest base rates in the industry. $20M+ paid to 100k+ contractors. D- BBB rating, class action lawsuit filed 2026 for sudden bans.

entry_barrier.test_description: Starter assessment: reading comprehension, grammar, critical thinking, instruction following. Coding assessment: algorithmic challenges, code correction, debugging explanations.
entry_barrier.experience_required: Strong English writing. Coding path requires Python/JS proficiency.

volume.description: Inconsistent. High for top performers, but 'permanent EQ' (empty queue) is a known risk. Work volume fluctuates with client demand.

quality.interest_level: High — requires genuine reasoning, judgment, and expertise
quality.tedious_tasks: Some general writing annotation can be repetitive

platforms.tos_automation: Strictly prohibited. Aggressive geolocation checks. VPNs forbidden. Bots will result in permanent ban.
platforms.best_for: Coders and strong writers in supported countries who want premium rates. Not viable for LATAM/Europe (except UK/Ireland).
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: No API, heavy ToS restrictions. Only feasible via browser automation with extreme caution. High risk of account loss.

platforms.name: Alignerr (by Labelbox)
platforms.signup_status: Open but heavily restricted. Many regions see 'Not Available Here Yet.' US-focused.

countries.notes: In practice US-only despite global claims. China, Bangladesh, many others blocked during ID verification.

payments.method: PayPal (primary), Stripe listed but unused, Deel for international
payments.notes: Retroactive review failures reported (CHP CLAUDE project). Workers report pre-payout deactivations with $800-$3k+ earnings withheld. Discord vanished taking labeling history.

entry_barrier.test_description: AI-driven screening → qualification assessment → Labelbox setup → project waitlist. Evaluation phases are often real work done unpaid.
entry_barrier.experience_required: Domain expertise (CS degree, professional writing, etc.)

volume.description: Major complaint — project gaps can last months after acceptance. Waitlist can be months.

quality.interest_level: High — WorldSim coding eval is genuinely interesting. Domain expert work is engaging.
quality.tedious_tasks: Voice work at $9/hr real rate is exploitative.

platforms.api_availability: None for contractors. Labelbox has API for enterprise clients.
platforms.tos_automation: Standard contractor restrictions. Likely prohibits automation.
platforms.best_for: Credentialed experts who can survive waitlist. High risk tolerance required. Sentiment is at historic lows (May 2026).
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: Unpaid eval phases and account deletion risk make automation ROI negative. Skip.

platforms.name: Outlier (by Scale AI)

countries.notes: Truly global but pay varies by country. $500M+ paid to 1M+ experts.

payments.notes: Global uniform pay (same rate regardless of country). AirTM has ID verification issues. Mass deactivations April 2026 with earnings withheld.

entry_barrier.test_description: Resume + LinkedIn required. Domain selection (up to 10). Skills screening (multiple choice/coding). Project-specific qualification. Hubstaff time tracking for some projects.
entry_barrier.pass_rate: Not published, but described as accessible
entry_barrier.experience_required: Domain expertise in selected field. Resume + LinkedIn required.

volume.description: Empty queues are the signature problem. Project-based, highly variable. Aether project winding down. Whitebeard recovering.

quality.interest_level: High. Coding and STEM projects are genuinely engaging. LeetCode-style for coding.

platforms.tos_automation: Standard restrictions. Hubstaff screenshots for some projects make automation impossible.
platforms.best_for: Global workers with domain expertise who can tolerate instability. Best overall balance of accessibility and pay for non-US workers.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: No API. Hubstaff screenshot monitoring blocks automation. Manual tool only.

platforms.name: Surge AI
platforms.accepting_users: Not directly. Invite-only/curated. DataAnnotation.tech is the public entry point.
platforms.signup_status: Closed for direct signup. Research Fellowship or direct recruitment only.

countries.notes: Tier-adjusted pricing: US/EU get top rates, India/Philippines 10-25% less. Specialty work converges globally.

payments.method: Direct deposit (bi-weekly), PayPal in some cases
payments.notes: Premium rates for experts. Medical, legal, finance specialists command highest rates. Ongoing contractor classification lawsuit.

entry_barrier.test_duration: Profile → written sample (60-90 min) → human interview → 3-5 weeks total
entry_barrier.test_description: Three stages: 1) Profile/Resume/GitHub auto-screen. 2) Written annotation sample (score 3-5 pairs + justify). 3) 30-min video interview calibrating against rubric.
entry_barrier.degree_required: Yes. Advanced degree for most roles. Board-certified for medical.
entry_barrier.experience_required: Elite credentials — Ivy League professors, NYT journalists, board-certified physicians.

volume.description: No public data on hours. Volume depends on client projects. Work can be plentiful or scarce.

quality.interest_level: Very high. Red-teaming top LLMs, direct impact on model safety. Most intellectually engaging work in the space.

platforms.tos_automation: Not publicly detailed but standard restrictions apply.
platforms.best_for: Elite experts only. Not viable for OWNEX automation (no open access, invite-only).
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: No open signup. Skip unless you have elite credentials and want manual work.

platforms.name: Stellar AI
platforms.signup_status: Open. Join annotator pool → wait for project matching.

countries.notes: Open globally. No country restrictions published.

payments.notes: One of the best-run platforms. Paid qualifications (rare). Guaranteed Hours Contracts for senior engineers. Empty queue hit hard Feb 2026.

entry_barrier.test_description: Online registration → unpaid skills assessment (research, writing, critical thinking) → enter waiting pool → project-based onboarding. AI tools prohibited during test.
entry_barrier.experience_required: Depends on track. Generalist: strong research/writing. Engineering: strong coding skills.

volume.description: Empty queue hit hard around Feb 2026. Projects paused without warning. Waiting pool can be months.

task_types: AI agent task creation (prompt + automated verifier)
Code review for AI coding agents
quality.interest_level: Very high — creating agent tasks and verifiers is genuinely challenging engineering work.
quality.tedious_tasks: Standard data annotation at entry level.

platforms.best_for: Engineers who want high rates ($35-$120/hr) for interesting agent-evaluation work. Must tolerate wait pool.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: No API. Interesting coding tasks make it worth manual monitoring. Agent-creation tasks align well with OWNEX automation skills.

platforms.name: Toloka (by Toloka AI)

countries.notes: Best global coverage. Strong demand for less-resourced languages.

payments.speed: Varies (weekly or monthly depending on project)
payments.notes: Regional pricing — same task pays different rates by location. Good for multilingual. Low ceiling for English-only in high-cost markets.

entry_barrier.test_description: Sign up (10 min) → identity verification → platform tutorials (free, ~2 hrs) → start tasks immediately. Lowest barrier of all platforms.

volume.steady: Yes — search relevance task pool is consistently large
volume.description: Most stable volume among global platforms. Search relevance evaluation from Yandex spillover.

quality.interest_level: Low-Medium. Mostly labeling and evaluation. Not coding-focused. Some AI agent training data tasks but limited.
quality.tedious_tasks: Yes — primarily labeling and repetitive evaluation.

platforms.api_availability: Yes — Toloka has a Python SDK and REST API for requesters. Workers can interact via API indirectly.
platforms.tos_automation: Prohibited for workers (velocity bans, spam checks). Requesters can use API to push tasks.
platforms.best_for: Global workers who want steady, easy-to-access work. Best multilingual platform. Not ideal for coding/reasoning.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: Has API (requester-side). Worker-side automation is prohibited and detected. Steady volume makes it viable for manual task execution. Coding tasks rare.

platforms.name: Prolific
platforms.signup_status: Open with waitlist for some demographics. OECD countries primarily.

countries.notes: OECD-focused. Excludes Turkey, Lithuania, Colombia, Costa Rica. Best coverage for Europe.

payments.notes: Enforced minimum £6/$8/hr floor. Most studies pay above minimum. Most reliable payout in the industry.

entry_barrier.test_description: Sign up → detailed 'About You' profile (demographics, skills) → wait for approval (24-48 hrs) → studies appear on dashboard. Pre-screened by profile.
entry_barrier.pass_rate: High (may be waitlisted if demographic oversaturated)
entry_barrier.experience_required: None. Demographic profile determines study matching.

volume.description: New study published ~every 2 minutes platform-wide. Individual matching varies. Peak during UK/US business hours.
volume.typical_weekly_hours: 5-15 for active users in well-supported countries.

quality.interest_level: Medium. Academic research can be interesting but not coding-focused.

platforms.api_availability: API for researchers only. No participant API.
platforms.tos_automation: Strictly prohibited. Attention checks detect automated responses.
platforms.best_for: Europe-based workers who want reliable, easy survey income. Not coding-focused but reliable pay.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: No API, attention checks prevent automation. Only manual. Low hourly rate makes ROI marginal. Good for filling time between coding tasks.

platforms.name: UHRS (Universal Human Relevance System, Microsoft)
platforms.accepting_users: Accessible only via partner platforms (Clickworker, Appen, OneForma, Toloka)
platforms.signup_status: Open through partners. Qualification tests required.

countries.notes: Country availability depends on partner platform. Clickworker has best coverage.

payments.speed: 7-31 days via partner platforms. Clickworker pays weekly (Friday).
payments.notes: Paid per HIT (task), not per hour. Speed determines effective rate. Quality bonuses on some HitApps.

entry_barrier.test_description: Register on partner platform → English proficiency test → UHRS registration assessment → access granted. Some HitApps have additional quals.
entry_barrier.experience_required: Basic English proficiency, attention to detail.

volume.description: HitApps come in batches. First come, first served. Requires regular checking. Velocity bans for rushing.

quality.interest_level: Low. Mostly search evaluation and labeling. Highly repetitive.
quality.tedious_tasks: Very tedious — relevance judgments on search results, image categorization.

platforms.tos_automation: Strictly prohibited. Velocity bans, spam HITs, hidden timers. Automation = permanent ban from all partner vendors.
platforms.best_for: Entry-level workers in any country. Low pay, tedious work, no coding.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: Heavy anti-automation (velocity bans, spam HITs). Not viable for automation. Low ROI for coding-focused system.

platforms.name: Appen / CrowdGen

countries.notes: Best country coverage. Especially strong for non-English languages.

payments.method: PayPal, Payoneer, AirTM, Swift bank transfer
payments.speed: Monthly — pay by 15th of following month (30-45 day wait for first payment)
payments.notes: Monthly pay cycle is slowest in the industry. Pay has decreased over time. Company had financial difficulties 2023-2024.

entry_barrier.test_duration: 30-60 min + 2-10 hrs unpaid training per project
entry_barrier.test_description: Sign up → fill profile → apply to projects → qualification exam (20-50 questions, 80%+ required). Search eval exams have <30% pass rate.
entry_barrier.pass_rate: Low for search eval, moderate for others
entry_barrier.experience_required: None for basic tasks. Language skills valued.

volume.description: Apply to projects, wait for acceptance. Projects end without notice. Can go weeks between projects.
volume.typical_weekly_hours: 10-20 when on a project; 0 between projects.

quality.interest_level: Low. Mostly evaluation and annotation. Coding tasks rare.
quality.tedious_tasks: High — image labeling, relevance rating, transcription.

platforms.tos_automation: Standard restrictions. Quality audits catch inconsistencies.
platforms.best_for: Multilingual workers in any country. Entry-level. Low pay ceiling.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: Monthly pay, low rates, tedious work, no coding. Low priority for OWNEX.

platforms.name: Telus International AI
platforms.signup_status: Open in 50+ countries. Application waves, not rolling.

countries.notes: More restricted than Appen. US/UK/India/Philippines have most openings.

payments.notes: Reliable but slow. 20-26 hr/week cap. Above average for search eval roles.

entry_barrier.test_description: Multi-part exam: 100+ page Search Quality Rater Guidelines to study, then theoretical test + practical rating test. 2-3 attempts. Pass rate <30%.
entry_barrier.experience_required: Strong attention to detail, ability to follow complex guidelines.

volume.steady: Moderate — 10-20 hrs/week consistent when on a project
volume.description: More stable than Appen once accepted. Fixed hour caps (20-26 hrs/week). Can drop suddenly when projects end.

quality.interest_level: Low. Repetitive search/response evaluation. AI response evaluation is newer but still rating-based.
quality.tedious_tasks: High — page after page of relevance judgments.

platforms.best_for: Workers who can pass hard exams and want reliable 10-20 hrs/week. Not coding-friendly.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: Hard exam, tedious work, no coding, monthly pay. Low priority.

platforms.name: OneForma (by Centific, formerly Pactera EDGE)

countries.notes: Excellent global coverage. Project availability varies by country/language.

payments.notes: Worst payment reputation in the space. PayPal $300/yr cap is a trap. Account deactivations with earnings lost. Slow support.

entry_barrier.test_description: Sign up → complete profile → pass certification tests → apply to projects. Auto-apply feature can resubmit stale scores.
entry_barrier.experience_required: Language skills for translation/transcription. None for basic annotation.

volume.description: Projects come and go. Some workers report weeks with nothing. UHRS access available through OneForma.

quality.interest_level: Low. Mostly language/annotation work. Some AI evaluation but not coding-focused.

platforms.best_for: Multilingual workers comfortable with risk. Avoid for coding/reasoning.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: Worst payment reputation. Account deactivation risk. Low rates. Skip.

platforms.name: Mindrift (by Toloka AI)

countries.notes: Global platform backed by Toloka AI. 20k+ experts.

payments.notes: Rates visible before each task. Coding projects $32-$90/hr. Senior Python/ML engineers at top of range.

entry_barrier.test_duration: Technical assessment (HackerRank for coding), CV review
entry_barrier.test_description: Two paths: 1) All-access (no CV, instant tasks — general annotation only). 2) Specialized: CV → technical assessment (multiple choice, coding, or AI interview) → onboarding. Coding: HackerRank-style assessment.
entry_barrier.pass_rate: Moderate for specialized; high for all-access
entry_barrier.degree_required: Preferred (70% have Masters/PhD). Not required for all-access.
entry_barrier.experience_required: Domain expertise for specialized projects. None for all-access tasks.

volume.description: Project-based. Active projects in coding, STEM, creative writing. All-access tasks available consistently.

quality.interest_level: High — coding projects involve reviewing AI-generated code, spotting bugs, evaluating architecture. Genuine senior engineer work.
quality.tedious_tasks: All-access tasks (labeling, basic rating) are lower quality.

platforms.best_for: Coders who want $32-$90/hr for interesting code evaluation work. Backed by Toloka AI, more stable than smaller platforms.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: No API. Coding tasks are high quality and align with OWNEX capabilities. Worth manual monitoring for high-value tasks.

platforms.name: Mercor
platforms.signup_status: Open. Strict screening. Global but US/EU primary.

countries.notes: Highest-paying platform. Strictest screening. Top 500 university preferred.

payments.notes: Highest rates in the industry. Globally uniform pay. Best for senior coders.

entry_barrier.interview_type: AI video interview (15 min, 6-8 questions, recorded + scored by model)
entry_barrier.test_duration: Profile → written sample (60-90 min) → AI interview → 3-6 weeks total
entry_barrier.test_description: Three stages: 1) Profile (GitHub, LinkedIn, vector-matched). 2) Written sample (code review or design). 3) AI video interview (model probes depth, specificity, failure cases).
entry_barrier.pass_rate: ~40% of Outlier-qualified coders fail Mercor pre-screen

volume.description: Project-matched. Work is project-based. Higher tier = more consistent work.

quality.interest_level: Very high. Senior-level code review, architecture evaluation. Most intellectually demanding platform.

platforms.best_for: Senior engineers with strong credentials who want $70-$130/hr. Not for automation.
platforms.ownex_integration_notes: No API. Strict AI interview screening. Only feasible manually and only for top-tier coders.

bonus_platforms.name: Handshake AI Fellowship
bonus_platforms.why_interesting: AI evaluation for college students/grads. US only. No coding required.

bonus_platforms.name: Invisible Technologies (Meridium Network)
bonus_platforms.why_interesting: AI training through Meridium Expert Network. Assessment + no interview. Generalist and specialist tracks.
bonus_platforms.score_note: Harder to evaluate, less public data. Assessment-based entry.

bonus_platforms.name: Babel Audio
bonus_platforms.score_note: Audio only. Not relevant for coding/reasoning.

bonus_platforms.name: iSoftStone
bonus_platforms.why_interesting: Search evaluation, similar to Telus/Appen. Global.
bonus_platforms.score_note: Search evaluation only. Low rates, tedious.

bonus_platforms.name: Clickworker (standalone, non-UHRS tasks)
bonus_platforms.why_interesting: Access to UHRS + standalone microtasks. Weekly pay. Global.
bonus_platforms.score_note: Listed under UHRS above. Standalone tasks are low-paid.

primary.reason: Best coding/reasoning work ($40-$65/hr). Highest quality tasks. No interview.
primary.limitation: Only 6 countries. Not available in most of LATAM/Europe.

primary_alternative.reason: Global availability. Good coding tasks ($30-$50/hr). No interview. Most balanced.

coding_specialist.reason: $32-$90/hr for code evaluation. No interview. Backed by Toloka AI. Interesting work.
coding_specialist.limitation: CV + assessment required. Less volume than Outlier.

coding_specialist.reason: $35-$120/hr for engineering. Agent-evaluation tasks are unique and interesting.
coding_specialist.limitation: Waiting pool can be months. Empty queue periods.

latam_europe_best.reason: Best global coverage with uniform pay. Coding tasks available.
Best global coverage. Steady work. Multilingual specialty pays well.
Open globally. Coding evaluation work. No interview.

top_recommendations_for_ownex.automation_potential: None of these platforms support API-based automation for workers. All prohibit bots/automation via ToS. UHRS has the strongest anti-automation measures (velocity bans, spam HITs). The only viable OWNEX integration pattern is browser-based automation with human-like behavior, which carries account loss risk on all platforms.

final_assessment.best_for_ownex_automation: No platform supports safe automation. Mindrift and Stellar AI offer the most interesting coding tasks but require manual execution.
final_assessment.best_for_ownex_manual_coding: 1) DataAnnotation.tech ($40-65/hr, if in supported country). 2) Mindrift ($32-90/hr, global). 3) Outlier ($30-50/hr, global).
final_assessment.best_for_latam_europe: Outlier (global, coding) > Mindrift (global, coding) > Toloka (global, no coding).
final_assessment.recommended_priority: Focus on Outlier + Mindrift as primary targets. Add Stellar AI for high-rate engineering tasks. Use Toloka for filler work between coding tasks.
